```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)

## Analysis objects: tables (tab), figures (fig) and values quoted in the text (info), saved by the master
## script in 'results/report-objects.rds' (see 'R/07-report-objects.R').
## The master script runs again if the file is missing, if an R script is more recent than the file, or with
## the parameter run_analysis (after a change in the data): quarto render Gambia-NFI-2026-report.qmd -P run_analysis:true
report_file    <- "results/report-objects.rds"
report_scripts <- c("Gambia-NFI-2026-master.R", list.files("R", pattern = "\\.R$", full.names = TRUE))

if (isTRUE(params$run_analysis) || !file.exists(report_file) || any(file.mtime(report_scripts) > file.mtime(report_file))) {
  source("Gambia-NFI-2026-master.R")
}

report_obj <- readRDS(report_file)
tab  <- report_obj$tab
fig  <- report_obj$fig
info <- report_obj$info

## Table formatting functions
source("report/report-functions.R")
```
